title: Marketing Lab One-Shot Benchmark Authorization Fence

notes: Refreshes the stale PR #79 authorization concept for the current DirectModelRuntime qualification path; Hermes remains dormant and is not reactivated.
A configured benchmark process performs only PostgreSQL authorization-state checks until an exact run ID/release SHA authorization exists.
The authorization is atomically consumed with creation of the durable started run record before any model lane can execute.
At most one benchmark authorization may be outstanding globally, and concurrent/overlapping processes cannot execute the same authorization twice.
Migration 0022 is code-only in this slice and is not applied to production by implementation or merge approval.
No deployment, DATABASE_URL mutation, provider/model/key/pricing change, benchmark execution, authorization insertion, customer data use, publishing, release or production enablement is in scope.
